# Screenshot Planning — Docstring Freshness Monitor

## Screenshots

### 1. Gutter Icons in Code Editor
- **Title:** "See Documentation Health at a Glance"
- **What to capture:** A Java or Python file with green, yellow, and red gutter icons next to documented functions/methods.

### 2. Hover Tooltip Detail
- **Title:** "Detailed Freshness Information"
- **What to capture:** Mouse hovering over a stale (red) gutter icon, showing the tooltip with last code change, last doc change, divergent commits, and freshness score.

### 3. Stale Doc Inspection Warning
- **Title:** "IDE Inspection Catches Stale Docs"
- **What to capture:** An editor showing the stale documentation inspection warning with the yellow/red underline and the quick-fix popup offering "Mark as reviewed" and "Update documentation" options.

### 4. Batch Analysis Results
- **Title:** "Project-Wide Documentation Audit"
- **What to capture:** The Inspect Code results panel showing stale documentation findings grouped by file and severity.

### 5. Project Dashboard (Pro)
- **Title:** "Documentation Freshness Dashboard"
- **What to capture:** The Doc Freshness tool window showing the project-wide dashboard with freshness statistics and the treemap visualization.

### 6. Settings Panel
- **Title:** "Customizable Freshness Thresholds"
- **What to capture:** The plugin settings page showing threshold configuration, language selection, and severity level options.

### 7. Multi-Language Support
- **Title:** "Works Across Languages"
- **What to capture:** A split view or tabs showing freshness icons in Java (Javadoc), Python (docstrings), and TypeScript (JSDoc) files.

### 8. Before/After Documentation Update
- **Title:** "Watch Scores Improve"
- **What to capture:** A side-by-side showing a stale doc (red icon, low score) and the same doc after updating (green icon, high score).

---

## Video Demo Outline (45 seconds)

| Time | Scene | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| 0-5s | Intro | Plugin name and tagline with a code file in background |
| 5-15s | Gutter icons | Scroll through a file showing fresh and stale documentation indicators |
| 15-25s | Hover detail | Hover over a stale icon to show the freshness tooltip |
| 25-35s | Fix stale doc | Update a stale docstring and show the icon changing from red to green |
| 35-40s | Dashboard | Open the project dashboard showing overall documentation health |
| 40-45s | CTA | "Install from JetBrains Marketplace" with plugin URL |
